{"assessments":[{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选明确说明声乐纠错需要按个人问题安排步骤，并列举声带闭合、声音挤压及真假声转换等例子；后半段转为连麦和付费教学引导，削弱了主题集中度。","candidate_id":"candidate_adab5d4da9ab2be6","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"声乐训练应先判断个人的基础问题并按合适顺序纠正，不能不分情况直接练假声、戏腔或强混。","risk_summary":"后半段包含教学服务和付费插队的推广内容。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"因人而异的声乐纠错顺序","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"关于呼吸和打嘟练习的开场没有继续解释，随后转向灯牌互动及对音乐天赋的看法；后一个观点可以独立理解，但重复较多且论证较薄。","candidate_id":"candidate_473a7cc73ef551ea","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"普通人学习唱歌不必先证明自己拥有出众的音乐天赋，真正有明显天赋的人很少。","risk_summary":"开头的练习教学主张未完成，内容还夹有多次直播互动推广。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"普通人学唱歌是否需要天赋","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选完整给出约课、单节价格和一对一课程定位，并用录播课与个人课程的进步比例作强烈对比；信息明确，但核心效果数据只有讲述者的单方陈述。","candidate_id":"candidate_bf1aa4701bd6f761","content_risk_flags":["legal_or_financial_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"讲述者主张一对一技术课比录播课更能带来进步，因此其课程按个人问题定价且不走低价路线。","risk_summary":"包含具体收费、涨价预告和未经独立佐证的课程效果宣传。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"一对一声乐课的定价与效果主张","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"开头告别和若干词句存在明显识别噪声，但后半段观点清楚：讲述者认为流行演唱高度依赖天赋，并以部分美声学习者唱流行时仍会跑调为例。百分比前后不一致，且论据主要是个人观察。","candidate_id":"candidate_368dc549dbba313f","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"讲述者认为唱好美声并不等于能唱好流行歌曲，流行演唱在很大程度上依赖天赋。","risk_summary":"开场识别较乱，关于天赋占比的数字也前后不一致。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"美声能力与流行演唱天赋的差异","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选给出了增加下方支撑、减少过高位置感以增强穿透力的具体反馈，但“上面”“下面”等表述依赖当时的示范或手势；后段关于音色和“变现”的识别也不稳定。","candidate_id":"candidate_729ff8b49cf26f22","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"讲述者判断学员的声音位置偏高、胸腔支撑不足，调整后可能增强声音穿透力并减轻疲累。","risk_summary":"声乐身体运用建议依赖未提供的现场示范，且部分关键用词可能存在识别错误。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"通过支撑和声音位置改善穿透力","uncertainty_flags":["visual_dependency","asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选以高音唱不上去和容易破音作为直接问题入口，随后给出缺少歌唱技巧、没有掌握发声通道这一解释；重复和直播互动较多，但核心观点完整。","candidate_id":"candidate_6b0ae4ac42937611","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"讲述者认为高音卡住或破音通常与未掌握合适的歌唱技巧和发声通道有关。","risk_summary":"涉及嗓音困难成因的概括性判断，发布时宜避免把它表述成适用于所有人的确定诊断。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"高音卡顿与发声通道","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选前段给出练熟歌曲、唱几句即可初步判断基础的建议，随后迅速转为灯牌和助理互动；可恢复出一个教学判断，但内容重复且部分词语识别不稳。","candidate_id":"candidate_7062f9ba2a253131","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"讲述者认为学员先把歌曲练熟后唱几句，老师通常就能初步听出其基础情况。","risk_summary":"部分评价词识别不清，后半段主要是粉丝灯牌推广。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"用短段演唱初步判断声乐基础","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选主要记录直播开场、机位调整和让助理重复欢迎语，能构成一个可理解的幕后互动单元，但没有形成有价值的声乐观点。","candidate_id":"candidate_f12c067f4578931f","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"讲述者在调整直播画面后，要求助理重新向观众介绍这是一个可以提问音乐问题的声乐教学直播间。","risk_summary":"","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"声乐直播开场与画面调整","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"前段明确说明发声来自声带振动，并指出气流经过声带时速度过快或过慢都不理想；随后大段转为礼物和课程引导，使教学内容被打断。","candidate_id":"candidate_e7e0739b77ace20a","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"讲述者认为声音由声带振动产生，发声时需要让气流以合适状态经过声带。","risk_summary":"包含人体发声机制的教学表述，后半段还有礼物与课程推广。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"气流经过声带形成振动发声","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选清楚表达了美声训练可能掩盖部分音准问题、流行演唱较依赖天赋的看法，也补充零基础学习者只需追求唱得更好；开头“每声”疑为识别错误，后段转为无关闲聊。","candidate_id":"candidate_8fac69f83a04a15d","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"讲述者认为美声表现好不必然代表音准或流行演唱能力好，但普通爱好者无需以职业标准要求自己。","risk_summary":"关键术语疑有识别错误，且后半段混入无关互动。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"美声训练、音准与业余流行演唱目标","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选可辨认的主线是反对高价录播课、主张线上一对一教学，并以交通成本和退款承诺降低顾虑；多处金额及课程词语识别损坏，不能可靠保留其精确数字。","candidate_id":"candidate_db82a842ff2401fa","content_risk_flags":["legal_or_financial_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"讲述者主张零基础学习者与其购买录播课，不如选择线上一对一课程，并宣称未进步可以退款。","risk_summary":"涉及课程价格、退款承诺和效果推广，但金额等关键措辞存在明显识别错误。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"录播课与线上一对一声乐课的选择","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"对话先建议学员继续唱自己喜欢且适合的抒情或节奏布鲁斯风格，随后转入校园比赛、原创音乐和跨专业经历；人物来回发言清楚，但主线较分散且部分词语识别不准。","candidate_id":"candidate_b7730933ffbad510","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","context_dependency"],"primary_claim":"讲述者鼓励学员发挥适合抒情和节奏布鲁斯的声音特点，不必因美声型选手的炫技表现而否定自己。","risk_summary":"个别曲风和账号相关词语识别不稳，观点也依赖前序对学员音色的评价。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"根据个人音色选择适合的演唱风格","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics","missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选用卧推动作中的憋气作对比，反对把唱歌简单解释为腹部发力，并借声带位置和纸张振动说明发声机制；核心观点明确，但现场指示和演示无法从纯文本核验。","candidate_id":"candidate_737064038099ef2a","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"讲述者认为唱歌不应照搬卧推时憋气和胸部用力的方式，发声的直接振动来源是声带。","risk_summary":"涉及身体用力与发声机制，且纸张和声带位置演示需要画面才能完整核验。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"唱歌发力与声带振动的区别","uncertainty_flags":["visual_dependency"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选把气息称为各种唱法的基础，并称基础环节有问题会导致高音长期停滞，同时穿插十节课退款承诺和学员案例；多处专业术语识别受损，教学与营销内容混合。","candidate_id":"candidate_de95d7468a7318ca","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","legal_or_financial_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"讲述者认为气息基础会影响高音训练效果，长期没有进步可能说明前期基础训练存在问题。","risk_summary":"声乐训练判断伴随退款和课程效果宣传，且多个关键术语存在识别错误。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"气息基础与高音训练停滞","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"开头存在较重识别噪声，但后续师生对话能辨认出鼻音偏多、高音发散和咬字位置调整等反馈；“这个通道”“往后”等建议依赖当时演唱与示范。","candidate_id":"candidate_5fc29cf6f9d6fbb3","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","context_dependency","visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"讲述者判断学员唱高音时鼻音偏多、声音容易发散，并建议调整咬字和声音位置以提高集中度。","risk_summary":"诊断依赖未提供的演唱声音与现场示范，开头若干词句也无法可靠识别。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"高音鼻音与声音集中度调整","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","visual_dependency","missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"}]}
